goal: Lock 1000+ anime as Route 2 SDX protagonist saga
body: New authorial canon: the 1000+ episode Shadow Dweller anime follows Route 2 Xoah, the Elseworlds dark future branch who becomes Dark Shadow Dweller Xoah (SDX). Film saga centers X² from Vol. 2 through Vol. 5. Anime retroactively reveals that the terrifying hunter seeded in Vol. 2 was its own protagonist, showing SDX's survival, hardening, Level 9 Akuma-tier evolution, pursuit of X², and eventual convergence into X² after the Shadow King mortally maims her. Treat Vol. 2 Route 2 as the hidden origin lane of the anime. Preserve delayed identity reveal in the films.
